# Episode format reference

Every key of `episode.yaml`, generated from the schema that validates it (`episodeJsonSchema()` in `packages/core/src/jsonschema.ts`). Objects are strict: an unknown key is error V-1 with a "did you mean" hint. `reelforge schema` writes the same schema as JSON for editor autocompletion.

Type `time` is a time expression: `12.5s`, `l7`, `l7.end`, `l7:'word'`, `l7:'word'#2`, `l7.3`, `@scene`, `@scene.end`, each with an optional offset such as `+0.4`. See [Writing episodes](../authoring.md) for examples and the [components reference](components.md) for `props`.

## Episode identity: `meta`

| Key                     | Type     | Default     | Required | Limits                          | Description                                                                  |
| ----------------------- | -------- | ----------- | -------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `meta`                  | object   |             | yes      |                                 | Episode identity and publishing texts                                        |
| `meta.id`               | string   |             | yes      | pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$` | Slug of the episode (folder name)                                            |
| `meta.series`           | string   | `""`        |          |                                 | Series name shown in the header                                              |
| `meta.title`            | string   | `""`        |          |                                 | Episode title                                                                |
| `meta.episode`          | integer  | `1`         |          | ≥ 1                             | Episode number shown in the header                                           |
| `meta.preset`           | string   | `"tiktok"`  |          |                                 | Platform layout: `tiktok`, `reels`, `shorts` or your own preset              |
| `meta.theme`            | string   | `"default"` |          |                                 | Theme name in `themes/`, or a relative path                                  |
| `meta.lang`             | string   | `"ar-EG"`   |          |                                 | Voice-over language, e.g. `en-US` (left to right) or `ar-EG` (right to left) |
| `meta.publish`          | object   |             |          |                                 | Texts written to `out/publish.md`                                            |
| `meta.publish.cover`    | string   |             |          |                                 | Short cover text                                                             |
| `meta.publish.caption`  | string   |             |          |                                 | Post caption                                                                 |
| `meta.publish.hashtags` | string[] | `[]`        |          |                                 | Hashtags                                                                     |
| `meta.publish.pinned`   | string   |             |          |                                 | Pinned comment                                                               |

## Audio: `audio`

| Key                     | Type                                                                            | Default       | Required | Limits      | Description                                                                |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | -------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `audio`                 | object                                                                          | `{}`          |          |             | Voice, sound effects and mastering                                         |
| `audio.voice`           | string                                                                          | `"voice.wav"` |          |             | Voice recording, relative to the episode folder                            |
| `audio.sfx`             | `auto` \| `none` \| `manual`                                                    | `"auto"`      |          |             | `auto`: components play their default sounds; `manual`: only listed sounds |
| `audio.sfx_gain_db`     | number                                                                          | `-16`         |          | ≥ -60, ≤ 12 | Sound effect level in dB                                                   |
| `audio.duck`            | boolean                                                                         | `true`        |          |             | Lower the effects under the voice                                          |
| `audio.denoise`         | boolean                                                                         | `false`       |          |             | Remove background noise from the voice (RNNoise)                           |
| `audio.extra`           | object[]                                                                        | `[]`          |          |             | Extra sounds at given times                                                |
| `audio.extra[].at`      | time                                                                            |               | yes      |             |                                                                            |
| `audio.extra[].sound`   | `whoosh` \| `hit` \| `ding` \| `err` \| `glitch` \| `tick` \| `tap` \| `typing` |               | yes      |             |                                                                            |
| `audio.extra[].gain_db` | number                                                                          |               |          |             |                                                                            |

## Script: `script`

| Key                | Type     | Default  | Required | Limits                             | Description                                |
| ------------------ | -------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `script`           | object[] |          | yes      | min 1 items                        | Spoken lines; ids default to `l1`, `l2`, … |
| `script[].id`      | string   |          |          | pattern `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` | Line id used in time expressions           |
| `script[].text`    | string   |          | yes      |                                    | What you say, one sentence                 |
| `script[].caption` | string   | `"auto"` |          |                                    | `auto`, `none` or a custom caption text    |
| `script[].break`   | string[] | `[]`     |          |                                    | Force a caption break before these words   |

## Chapters: `chapters`

| Key                | Type     | Default | Required | Limits | Description                                            |
| ------------------ | -------- | ------- | -------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `chapters`         | object[] | `[]`    |          |        | Chapter labels on the progress bar and in `publish.md` |
| `chapters[].at`    | time     |         | yes      |        |                                                        |
| `chapters[].label` | string   |         | yes      |        |                                                        |

## Scenes: `scenes`

| Key                     | Type                                                             | Default       | Required | Limits                             | Description                                                           |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `scenes`                | object[]                                                         |               | yes      | min 1 items                        | Scenes in order; each starts at a time and ends where the next starts |
| `scenes[].id`           | string                                                           |               | yes      | pattern `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].at`           | time                                                             |               | yes      |                                    | Start time (usually a line, e.g. `l3`)                                |
| `scenes[].end`          | time                                                             |               |          |                                    | End time (default: next scene start)                                  |
| `scenes[].glow`         | string \| object[]                                               |               |          |                                    | Background glow color, or a list of timed colors                      |
| `scenes[].glow[].at`    | time                                                             |               | yes      |                                    |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].glow[].color` | string                                                           |               | yes      |                                    |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].transition`   | `crossfade` \| `cut` \| `slide-up` \| `zoom` \| `push` \| `blur` | `"crossfade"` |          |                                    | How the scene replaces the previous one                               |
| `scenes[].camera`       | `still` \| `drift` \| `push-in` \| `pull-out`                    | `"still"`     |          |                                    | One slow camera move across the scene                                 |
| `scenes[].layout`       | `stage` \| `full`                                                | `"stage"`     |          |                                    | `stage` (between header and captions) or `full` (whole canvas)        |
| `scenes[].row`          | object                                                           |               |          |                                    | Lay out elements side by side                                         |
| `scenes[].row.gap`      | integer                                                          |               |          | ≥ 0                                |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].row.align`    | `start` \| `center` \| `end`                                     |               |          |                                    |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].row.x`        | integer                                                          |               |          |                                    |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].row.y`        | integer                                                          |               |          |                                    |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].row.w`        | integer                                                          |               |          | &gt; 0                             |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].row.h`        | integer                                                          |               |          | &gt; 0                             |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].column`       | object                                                           |               |          |                                    | Stack elements vertically                                             |
| `scenes[].column.gap`   | integer                                                          |               |          | ≥ 0                                |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].column.align` | `start` \| `center` \| `end`                                     |               |          |                                    |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].column.x`     | integer                                                          |               |          |                                    |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].column.y`     | integer                                                          |               |          |                                    |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].column.w`     | integer                                                          |               |          | &gt; 0                             |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].column.h`     | integer                                                          |               |          | &gt; 0                             |                                                                       |
| `scenes[].columns`      | integer                                                          |               |          | ≥ 1, ≤ 6                           | Split the stage into lanes (elements pick one with `col`)             |
| `scenes[].gutter`       | integer                                                          |               |          | ≥ 0                                |                                                                       |

| Key                                 | Type                                                                                                                                                                                          | Default  | Required | Limits                              | Description                                             |
